description_short: Physical AI, independent industrial reconstruction, and civic services.
description_long: Rebuild a mature island around physical AI infrastructure. Validate Models, choose independent industrial and mobility applications, and invest in optional Civic Knowledge or planetary coordination. Native technologies, material costs, power, maintenance, and deliberate construction remain. Earlier Program reinvestment supports later megaprojects; beamed power is optional. Includes original mod-owned building, product, Fiber, rack, vehicle, and train models.
